exposure: Bichorionic biamniotic twin pregnancies with single IUFD
Bichorionic biamniotic twin pregnancies with both fetuses alive
Single intrauterine fetal death (IUFD) in bichorionic biamniotic twin pregnancies
cohort: 73 bichorionic biamniotic twin pregnancies (22 with single IUFD after 14 weeks and 51 with both fetuses alive)
finding: The study found that single IUFD in bichorionic biamniotic twin pregnancies was associated with a higher incidence of IUGR in the surviving fetus compared to the first fetus of pregnancies with both fetuses alive.
mod_finding: While this study doesn't directly compare modes of delivery, it notes a high C-section rate in both groups (single intrauterine fetal death and those with both fetuses alive) within the context of bichorionic biamniotic twin pregnancies.
